insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Earlier UIN variant; 15-day free look (pre-IRDAI 2024 update). Plus Benefit doubles SI in 2 years, Secure Benefit doubles SI on Day 1, Protect Benefit removes non-medical expense deductions.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Room rent (any category, no cap), road ambulance up to SI, dental & plastic surgery due to injury, day care procedures.

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Home Health Care with cashless facility.

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Donor expenses covered up to SI.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance up to Sum Insured; Emergency Air Ambulance optional.

critical_illness_cover.notes: E-Opinion for Critical Illness available as optional cover.

notable_exclusions_summary: Earlier UIN of Optima Secure; introduced 2x SI Plus + Secure benefits, no room rent cap, no co-pay. Standard IRDAI exclusions.
available_riders: Plus Benefit (50% SI added in Y2 + Y3)
Secure Benefit (100% SI added at inception)
